title: Nigeria Local Government Areas and FCT Area Councils
description: Independently compiled factual administrative reference data for Nigeria's 768 Local Government Areas and the Federal Capital Territory's six Area Councils.
methodology: Independently compiled and cross-verified factual administrative reference data. SoftData normalised the seed material to title case, resolved obvious punctuation artifacts, and used the approved Nigeria constitutional/FCTA/INEC/NBS source hierarchy. The Federal Capital Territory is represented as six Area Councils, and geopolitical-zone membership is derived via the state dataset. Normalization notes: parenthetical or punctuation artifacts in the working seed were collapsed to stable public names where needed, and Abuja Municipal is used for the FCT area council.
